name: Device Simulator
description: Private iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Vision Pro and Android devices with shared task views and tools. Idle shutdown preserves data. Apple: macOS 15+, Apple Silicon, Xcode and matching runtimes. Android: Mac, Windows/Linux x64; SDK setup requires consent. Apple backend uses Baguette (Apache-2.0).
whenToUse: iPhone/iPad, Apple TV, Vision Pro and Android emulators; App installation and launch, real input, TV remote, Vision spatial gestures, screenshots, UI inspection, state and logs. Use devices first and verify outcomes.

environment.description: Read-only iOS and Android environment, runtime and model discovery. platforms reports readiness and errors. Use devices first for existing devices. Missing Android components are installed through settings after the user reviews sizes and licenses; this tool downloads nothing. Includes iOS, tvOS and visionOS (xrOS identifiers) runtimes and device types.

devices.description: Call first: list private devices. tasks/thisTask describe selection only; activeTasks/thisTaskActive describe task activity in the last 15 minutes. usage is active/idle/unknown; operation describes running work. Prefer this task’s recent devices. tasks=0 does not mean free; inspect running devices with unknown activity. Listing does not renew activity.

device.description: Manage private devices. create uses runtime/deviceType from environment (roughly 7–12 GB each); reuse a suitable device first. boot waits for readiness; screenshot=true optionally adds an image within budget. shutdown keeps data; rename changes its name. erase removes apps/data; delete removes the device: only at user request. activity renews task use for 15 min; release ends use without stopping apps/devices (not an exclusive reservation). Android import_media copies an absolute image/video path to Downloads (≤128 MiB); inspect copied, scanRequested, path and importError before retrying. Run switch applies; viewers and active tools prevent idle shutdown. taskBindingError/appContextError preserve operation results: check storage, do not repeat completed operations. Android partial: completedSteps, failedStep, deviceError; inspect before retry.

app.description: install: built iOS simulator .app or single Android .apk via absolute appPath; no AAB/split APK. Identical content skips; Android otherwise installs fully, iOS may sync. Poll jobs with install_status; modeReason explains the choice. info + appPath checks matchesLocal; comparisonError/verification=unconfirmed never warrants reinstall. launch relaunches by default; arguments/env are iOS-only. appLaunched=true confirms launch; if only preview fails, retry viewer open. Android appLaunched=false: inspect launchError, execution and appTerminated (null=unknown); never replay blindly. screenshot.error preserves success. terminate stops; uninstall deletes app/data; open_url opens deep links (observe confirmations). BUSY names operation/device/job after at most 1s pre-execution wait. taskBindingError/appContextError preserve results; inspect storage before retrying. Apple builds must match the target platform; compatible iPad Apps on Vision Pro use full install. Switching does not copy or launch Apps.

screenshot.description: Capture the upright screen; supported Cindy hosts attach an image, otherwise open path with an image tool. Default: 1 pixel=1 view point; grid=true adds labelled coordinates, region crops, scale 2–3 adds detail (divide coordinates by scale and add region origin). iOS adds corner/Dynamic Island masks by default. Android returns a rectangular framebuffer without added physical corner/cutout masks; it does not verify physical occlusion or safe areas. corners is iOS-only; Android accepts omitted/false and rejects explicit true before reading the screen.

describe_ui.description: Read the on-screen elements (accessibility tree). Default: a compact list in reading order with role, text, id, frame and center in view points (tap the center directly). Filter with query/role; x,y returns what is under a point; mode=full returns the whole tree. Games and custom-drawn UIs without accessibility get the text read off the screen instead (source=ocr), with positions; use screenshot for icons without text. OCR failure is an error, not evidence that no text is visible. tvOS/visionOS return OCR text lists in every mode (including full and x,y point queries), without accessibility trees or element IDs. Apple TV coordinates are for observation; operate with remote buttons.

tap.description: Real touch tap through the simulator's system touch path: no window, works while the Mac is locked, and the app receives a finger touch. Target an element by text or id (optional role, nth); in games, text matches the words read off the screen. Or tap a view point x,y (if the screen turned since you looked, it asks you to look again instead of tapping the wrong place). count=2 double-taps; duration≥0.5 long-presses. Returns the new elements about 0.6 s later (observe=ui); observe=screenshot attaches a screenshot. Never inject events into the app process. until=text waits for that text to appear (next page, dialog) instead of guessing settle. settle is 0–5 seconds, default 0.6; use until or wait_for for longer transitions. Vision Pro projects image coordinates into a single-hand pinch selection/hold. Use press remote buttons on Apple TV.

gesture.description: Gestures in screenshot view points: swipe from→to or direction; drag after hold seconds; pinch center/from_spread→to_spread; pan from/by. iOS also supports system edge and scroll_to. Vision supports swipe/drag/pinch/pan; use kind=spatial for depth dragging, rotation and camera navigation. Apple TV uses press. observe/until as in tap. Vision Pro: gaze, pinch-drag (depth in metres), two-hand pinch (scale) and rotate (angle in degrees); tilt/pan/orbit/dolly/move/reset camera. from/to/center are screenshot view points. by is [horizontal,vertical] degrees for tilt/orbit or [right,up] metres for pan (two axes only); move uses [right,up,back] metres. Use move or dolly for depth. dolly distance is metres, negative forward. Screenshot again after moving the camera. observe/until as in tap. Uses system input, not App injection. settle is 0–5 seconds, default 0.6; use until or wait_for for longer transitions.

type_text.description: Type into the focused field. auto (default) pastes any language in regular apps; games without accessibility use up to 300 US-keyboard characters (iOS switches Pinyin-like sources to English). Force paste or type as needed. Android type is ASCII-only, Unicode uses clipboard, cmd maps to Ctrl. keys accepts Enter, Escape, Backspace, Tab, arrows or cmd+A; clear=true selects all and deletes first. Confirm focus and observe the result; Enter may submit in games. observe/until work as in tap. touch uses a focused field's paste menu on iOS/Android, preserving the screen keyboard; it requires an available paste menu and rejects clear=true or keys. On iOS, key input hides the screen keyboard. Only iOS attempts hardware-keyboard record cleanup about 3 seconds after key input; refocus to check recovery, which is not guaranteed. Vision Pro auto pastes; tvOS auto/type uses up to 300 US-keyboard characters (select English first) without Unicode or clipboard paste. Both support keys; neither supports touch.

press.description: iOS and Android: home, lock, power, volume-up, volume-down, app-switcher, swipe-to-app-switcher, swipe-to-home, pull-down-to-notification-center, release-input. iOS only: action, pull-down-to-lock-screen. Android only: back, shake; the notification-center button expands notifications, not the lock screen. Unsupported buttons fail before input. duration (0–10 seconds) holds hardware keys only. release-input releases stuck keys and stops repeats without restarting or closing Apps. Apple TV: up/down/left/right/select/back/menu/home/play-pause/volume-up/volume-down. Vision Pro: digital-crown (home alias). Both support release-input.

wait_for.description: Return once a condition holds (up to 90 s) instead of fixed sleeps and repeated screenshots. text or id appears (gone=true: disappears; in games, the text read off the screen); stable=seconds: the screen changes less than tolerance (percent of pixels, default 0.5) for that long, optionally only within region; log=regex: a matching line in the app's log (with bundleId). screenshot=true attaches the screen. If it does not happen: met=false, the reason and the current screen; for game animation, a suggested tolerance. Images use the call’s remaining time budget; failure or exhausted budget preserves the wait result with screenshot.error. Request screenshot separately if needed. goalMet mirrors met; false means the condition was not met, not a passing acceptance check.

capture.description: Record frames before action (tool: tap, gesture, press, type_text, open_url or app_launch; args: its arguments), then for seconds (≤15) afterwards. Deduplicate frames into a time-ordered contact sheet labelled in milliseconds plus frame files. For transitions, animation, toasts and loading; omit action to record current changes. Supported hosts attach sheets up to 130 KB; otherwise open the sheet path with an image tool. Requires fixed orientation, size and panel, checked before/after action and recording; per-frame rotation tracking is unsupported. All stages share this call’s deadline. Capture failure or exhausted time returns captureError (code, message) with action or actionError and execution retained. actionError includes code, message and execution. Inspect executed/unknown outcomes; never blindly repeat the action. The action starts only after a complete first frame and screen confirmation; failure before then returns captureError with execution=not_executed.

set_state.description: Change orientation, posture, appearance, contrast, text_size, network profile/offline/clear or {latency,bandwidth,loss}, location, status_bar, privacy {action,service,bundleId}. iOS-only: hinge, location=clear, privacy reset; iOS permissions terminate Apps. Android: no hinge/arbitrary loss; {lat,lon} enables location; clear rejects before batch writes. offline/100-loss disables Wi-Fi/data; other profiles enable both; network=clear restores full bandwidth/no delay. Permissions: specific grant/revoke, API23+; photos/media-library use shared READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE below33, READ_MEDIA_* from33; motion API29+. App declarations apply. API preflight failure means no batch writes. One deadline. Stop on failure: applied=complete fields; Android appliedSteps=successful field/step; stateError=field/step/code/message/execution. Partial progress is not not_executed; do not replay. Rotation screen only if confirmed; null current=unconfirmed. TV/Vision: no orientation/posture/status_bar; other states runtime-dependent.

logs.description: Read recent logs: last_seconds defaults to 120, limit to 150, level to default; error/info/debug also supported, match is regex. iOS default includes ordinary Default messages, not a warning threshold; iOS includes device/process crash summaries; diagnostic failure retains logs with crashesError; crashes=false skips diagnostics. Android default means warning+; Android returns raw lines filtered from at most the latest 3000 logcat records: main+crash buffers, or main only with crashes=false; no iOS crash summaries. Android bundleId/process scopes only to the current exact PID, excluding logs/crashes from previous PIDs after exit/restart; absent processes return processRunning=false. Empty logs do not prove no crash. For historical evidence, explicitly omit process scope and inspect device logs.

heal.description: Repair only after the user accepts the platform-specific restart: iOS restarts SpringBoard in the private device set and terminates running Apps; Android reboots the entire emulator and ends all Apps. After Android reboot, wait for devices to report Booted before continuing. Try press(release-input) first for stuck keys.

viewer.description: Open/close the task live view; check previewOpened. Closing leaves devices/apps running. Switching only selects; stopped devices need Open. User controls: touch, keyboard, wheel/pinch, clipboard (replaces computer/device text), file/app install (may overwrite apps), rotate, shake, screenshot and start/stop. Android: APK/image/video import up to 128 MiB; silent WebM recording up to 5 min/128 MiB, letterboxed on rotation. iOS advanced tools: location/motion, status bar, persistent network, camera input, notifications (may trigger app behavior), accessibility, logs and video export (may contain private app data); map requests go via proxy to OpenStreetMap. Disclose these before opening; opening performs none of them. Loopback only. taskBindingError/appContextError preserve results; inspect records. outcome=partial: follow nextAction, retry viewer only.
